scb.grammar_1: Present tense of gustar (me gusta, te gusta, le gusta, nos gusta + noun/infinitive)
scb.grammar_2: Verb ser + descriptive adjectives (es/son + adjective) for describing hobbies
scb.register: informal spoken (classroom pair negotiation) → formal written recommendation
scb.transfer_goal: Write a formal recommendation letter to the school activities coordinator proposing the hobby your pair agreed on, with at least three reasons using gustar and ser + adjective, rewritten in formal Spanish
success_criteria: Use gustar + noun/infinitive at least three times to express hobby preferences (e.g., 'Me gusta el fútbol porque es emocionante')
Use ser + adjective at least three times to characterize hobbies (e.g., 'El senderismo es activo y relajante')
Negotiate a joint top hobby recommendation using evidence from both students' private rankings
Resolve the Paso 4 values conflict: agree on one hobby despite having different value priorities (creative vs. active)
Produce the Paso 5 class recommendation statement: 'Nuestra pareja recomienda [hobby] para el programa porque es [adj1] y [adj2]...'

adb.confirmed_complication: Values conflict — students each privately rank 5 hobbies and discover in Paso 4 that they value different qualities: one partner prioritizes creative/expressive activities (creativo/a, divertido/a), the other prioritizes active/physical activities (activo/a, emocionante). Only one hobby can fill the after-school program slot; students must negotiate across incompatible value systems and produce a shared justification using gustar and ser.
adb.confirmed_outcome: Partners agree on ONE hobby to recommend for the after-school program and produce a Paso 5 class declaration sentence with at least two reasons using gustar and ser. The declaration is shared with the class for comparison.
adb.gap_summary: Oral gap — each student holds a private hobby ranking (Paso 1) that cannot be shown to the partner; rankings are exchanged verbally (Paso 2), compared (Paso 3), and reconciled despite a values conflict (Paso 4). The communicative stake is exclusive program slot occupancy — only one hobby can be recommended, so both students must persuade the other or accept a principled compromise before any agreement is possible.
